m15.text: Yisan and Jalira, both trying to rob the same rambling Thunian man in the market of Lesh, compete over their mark until guard commander Dexros tries to arrest them, so Yisan spooks the guards' horses with a hummed tune and Jalira turns the thrown guards into frogs as they flee.

Outside the city Yisan reads the stolen journal of the Thunian scout Hastric, which reveals a sliver hive with abandoned treasure, and Jalira decides to go, so they journey through the Kalonian Forest fending off corrupted beasts.
At the sliver cave Jalira, over Yisan's objections, uses blue smoke on the slivers, and the two are transformed into slivers and fight to keep their minds against the hive's hum.
The hivelord drops their sliver forms and lets them take clothing and treasure, and Yisan decides to stay and study the slivers' music while Jalira takes the treasure to Martyne.
